content.title: Ohio State vs TCU: Start Time, Channel, Prediction, How To Watch March Madness on CBS, HBO Max, and More
content.text: Published March 19, 2026, 10:30 a.m. ET 'Rooster's Phil Dunster Reveals "The Bed Wasn't Supposed To Break" In Steve Carell Fight Scene0 seconds of 0 secondsVolume 0%Loading ad00:2500:0001:24 Live from the Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, South Carolina, No. 8 Ohio State battles No. 9 TCU in the first round of March Madness! It’s always difficult to predict an 8/9 matchup. The Buckeyes (21-12) had their four-game winning streak snapped after a tough 71-67 loss to Michigan in the Big Ten tournament. The Horned Frogs (22-11) had a similar streak, winning six-straight games before losing a 78-73 contest to Kansas in the Big 12 tourney. Ohio State is currently a 2.5-point favorite on DraftKings. The Frogs are 7-11 all-time in the tournament, with the Buckeyes March Madness record standing at an impressive 58-34. We’re predicting an Ohio State win to kick off March Madness 2026! How can you watch all the fun online? From start time to streaming info, here’s where to stream today’s Ohio State-TCU game live online. What Time Does The Ohio State-TCU Game Start? The first game of Match Madness 2026 starts today at 12:15 p.m. ET on CBS and NCAA.com. Where To Watch The Ohio State-TCU March Madness Game Live: Every March Madness game is available to stream (with a cable login) on the March Madness Live app/website. You can also watch Ohio State/TCU live on CBS, Paramount+ (more on that below), and the CBS website. Additionally, you can also stream CBS live with an active subscription to Fubo, DIRECTV, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, or Sling TV (via the Blue package). How To Watch March Madness Live on Paramount+: You can watch every CBS March Madness game on Paramount+ Premium. From now until Tuesday, March 31, Paramount+ is available for only $2.99/month for your first two months. You can also purchase Paramount+ Premium through Prime Video, which is currently offering the same $2.99/month deal. You can only watch March Madness games airing on CBS live via Paramount+’s Premium tier (not the Essential plan). Finally, you can add Paramount+ to your Hulu account for an additional 13.99/month. Photo: NCAA Does Paramount+ Offer a Free Trial? Nope. Paramount+ isn’t currently offering a free trial. Will Ohio State vs. TCU Be Streaming on HBO Max? Nope. Only March Madness games airing on TBS, TNT, and truTV will be available on HBO Max. The Ohio State/TCU game starts today at 12:15 p.m. ET on CBS. Tags CBS Sports
